description: Source code for a Linux/Darwin implementation of setproctitle, providing functions to modify the process title.

methods.name: spt_clearenv
methods.description: Clears the environment variables, using clearenv() if available.

methods.name: spt_copyenv
methods.description: Copies environment variables from old environment to current environment.

methods.name: spt_init
methods.description: Initializes the process title modification context, saving original argv and environment.

methods.name: setproctitle
methods.description: Sets the process title to a formatted string.
